I’m Lassaad, a software engineering student based in Tunisia.

MY BACKGROUND

Useful software.
Room to explore.

I study software engineering at MedTech, South Mediterranean University, and expect to graduate in June 2027. I build web and mobile applications, AI tools, and interactive experiences in Unity and Roblox.

My preferred direction is Cloud and AI. My projects often start with a practical need: finding answers in documents, making spreadsheets easier to use, organizing study notes, or remembering places I have explored. Games give me another space to experiment with interaction and world-building.

Through internships at Ooredoo and FORVIA, I have gained experience in software development and automated testing. I’m looking for a six-month final-year project or internship from January to June 2027.
